examples.arabic: هذه سيارات جميلة تقف امام الملعب
examples.english: These are beautiful cars standing in front of the stadium.
examples.transliteration: Hadhihi sayyaraat jameela taqifu amama al malab.

examples.english: These are beautiful cars in front of the school.
I see many cars on the street.

examples.arabic: هم راوا سيارات جميلة كثيرة خارج الملعب
examples.english: They saw many beautiful cars outside the stadium.
examples.transliteration: Hum ra'aw sayyaraat jameelah katheerah kharij al-mal'ab
